test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 25 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The Guinness world record for the highest number of songs recorded in a day is held by an Indian Playback Singer. How many songs in a day were recorded?
solution:
The correct answer is __**28.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kumar Sanu** is the world record holder for recording** 28 songs in a single day.**
 
• Kumar Sanu made this record in 1993 when he recorded 28 songs in a single day. 
 
• Kumar Sanu is the stage name of Ke**darnath Bhattacharya **who came to fame for his big break in **Aashiqui, in 1990. **
 
• Famous singer Kumar Sanu is known for his evergreen songs.
 
• There is also a record in the name of this legendary singer who has given many memorable songs of Bollywood. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The longest singing marathon by an individual lasted 105 hours and was achieved by **Sunil Waghmare (India) in Nagpur, India, from 3 to 7 March 2012.**
 
• Asha Bhosale. Legendary Bollywood playback singer Asha Bhosle has entered the Guinness World Records for the most number of single studio recordings.
 
• She is best known for her playback singing in Hindi cinema. Asha has recorded up to** 11,000 solo,** duets and chorus-backed songs.
 
• **Balasubrahmanyam **won the Guinness World Record for recording the highest number of songs by a singer: they Sang over **40,000 songs in 16 languages.**
